'''Deluxe Media Inc.''' (stylized as simply '''Deluxe''') is a production company and recording studio founded in 1915 currently owned by the firm Platinum Equity that produces the English [[dub|dubs]] of [[Pokémon animation]] through their offices in {{wp|Burbank, California}}. 

==English projects==
*[[Pokémon Generations]]
*[[Pokémon: Twilight Wings]]
*[[Pokémon: Hisuian Snow]]

==English voice directors==
*[[Ellyn Stern]] ([[Pokémon Generations]])
*[[Laura Post]] ([[Pokémon: Twilight Wings]], [[Pokémon: Hisuian Snow]])
